raw.query: SELECT o.img, o.avg_expected AS operator_ms, m.meas_encode AS physical_vllm_ms, ROUND((100*(o.avg_expected-m.meas_encode)/m.meas_encode)::numeric,3) AS pct_diff FROM (SELECT img, AVG(vision_expected_ms) avg_expected FROM provenance.measured_request WHERE vision_expected_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY img) o JOIN (SELECT num_images, AVG(encode_ms) meas_encode FROM provenance.vllm_vision_encode GROUP BY num_images) m ON o.img=m.num_images ORDER BY o.img
